newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine firms reject bids for 53,000T wheat.
newsitem.headline: Philippine firms reject bids for 53,000T wheat.

text.p: Philippine flour mills rejected tenders for 53,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat, traders that participated in the bidding told Reuters on Wednesday.
"All the bids submitted were unrealistically high," an official from one of the buyers said.

Philippine flour mills invited tenders earlier for 41,000 tonnes of dark northern spring wheat with a 14 percent protein content and 12,000 tonnes of western white wheat for November and December shipments.
Another group of flour millers also told traders they plan to buy another 56,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat.
Philippine flour mills are expected to buy 200,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat for their November and December requirements, traders said.

"We're not going to buy that much. We have enough inventories to last us till Christmas. We're only in the market to take advantage of the drop in the prices in Chicago and Minneapolis overnight," an executive in one of the flour mills said.
